newsitem.title: USA: Randers Viridian unit lands contract.
newsitem.headline: Randers Viridian unit lands contract.

text.p: Randers Group Inc said Wednesday its wholly owned Viridian Technology Inc subsidiary received an order for a custom modular chemical process equipment system valued at $570,000.
This latest system will be the second one designed and fabricated for the research and development division of an East Coast plastics resin manufacturer.
Viridian Technology also has pre-proposal work near completion with three other industrial customers that is expected to lead to additional system orders.
